observation.visible_scene: A dance studio with a wall of mirrors, ballet barres, light-blue panels and string lights along the mirror tops. A woman with a ponytail, pink face mask, black short-sleeve crop top, white shorts and white sneakers stands with her back to the camera, facing the mirror, so her front view appears as a reflection. A smartphone lies flat on the floor near the base of the mirror. The camera viewpoint and background stay fixed across the excerpt.
visible_changes: The woman performs small dance moves in place: her torso and hips rotate and sway left-right while her feet stay roughly wide apart.
Around t=0.2-0.5 the heel of her left foot lifts off the floor as her weight shifts, then re-plants.
Around t=0.8-1.1 the right foot's heel lifts and her ponytail swings to the side as her upper body turns.
Around t=1.5-1.9 her feet draw closer together and her body turns, hair swinging again.
Around t=2.1-2.4 she leans forward and extends her left leg outward/backward in a kick-like gesture, then retracts it by t=2.5-2.6 to a planted wide stance.
Her arms remain bent in front of her chest throughout, with only minor position changes.
The mirror reflection reproduces every motion from the front (e.g., the leg extension and torso turns are visible in the reflected figure).
outside_clip_unknowns: The choreography before t=0 and after t=2.67 is not shown; this is a mid-segment crop, so the routine may continue or have started earlier.
Whether audio/music drives the timing is unseen.
The purpose of the phone on the floor (recording device or prop) is not established.
uncertain_details: Exact frame-level timing of each foot lift is approximate given the 15 fps sampling.
The leg extension looks like a controlled dance gesture rather than a full kick; its intended form is not certain.
No camera motion is evident, but minor framing differences are within measurement noise.
